entities.summary: The Centre de Formació Interdisciplinària Superior, better known as CFIS, is a center of excellence associated with the Polytechnic University of Catalonia that allows excellent students to access a program of double degrees via an entrance exam. Centro de Formación Interdisciplinaria Superior is a university in Europe, established in 1999. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
